summary: DWS cluster I/O overload root cause diagnosis skill, based on KooCLI v3.2.0+ and DWS Autopilot MCP Server. Automatically collects I/O metrics, analyzes root causes (customer-side / system-side) via three-stage decision tree, and outputs a standardized diagnosis report. Applicable to DWS cluster I/O usage too high, I/O alarms, disk I/O load anomaly scenarios. Trigger words: "I/O高", "I/O告警", "I/O诊断", "I/O过载", "IO高", "IO告警", "IO诊断", "IO过载", "磁盘IO负载异常", "util打满", "await高", "high I/O", "I/O alarm", "I/O diagnosis"
